decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk line extends the firm's core office business and was featured on its own page in both years, so it likely meets aspirations in a market with growing demand for adjustable workplaces.
The chair family sits close to the established offer and kept a dedicated page, and premium chair families usually run for many years, so there is no sign of a shortfall that would prompt search.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory with uncertain volume, but they cost little to carry given the firm's slack and they support the rug line, so the firm keeps them for now.
The designer sofa by EOOS was promoted as new in 2019 and belongs to the firm's core upholstery business, where model lifecycles are long and results are likely satisfactory.
The high standing table complements the office and conference range at low cost, and with flat industry turnover there is no evident shortfall against aspirations.
Although the rug collection is distant from the core offer, it is a flagship of the firm's strategic direction, and the firm's hiring and slack let it carry the line while results mature.
